name: Four Seasons Resort & Residences Cartagena
insider_take: This ultra-luxe Four Seasons rises like a modern fortress within the UNESCO World Heritage walls of Old Cartagena, where Caribbean glamour meets colonial grandeur.
whats_special: The resort occupies a prime position on Tierra Bomba Island with unobstructed views of Cartagena's iconic skyline. It's the only luxury resort accessible by private boat transfer, creating an exclusive island sanctuary just 10 minutes from the historic walled city. The property features Colombia's first overwater spa treatment rooms and a championship golf course designed by Jack Nicklaus.
pro_tip: Book your arrival transfer during golden hour – the boat ride offers spectacular sunset views of Cartagena's fortress walls and colorful colonial facades reflected in the Caribbean waters.
dont_miss: The rooftop infinity pool overlooking Bocagrande's skyline, sunset cocktails at Agua by internationally acclaimed chef Juan Manuel Barrientos, and the resort's exclusive access to pristine Playa Blanca – consistently rated among South America's most beautiful beaches.
pros: Prime location in historic Cartagena's walled city
Exceptional Four Seasons service and luxury amenities
Stunning rooftop pool with panoramic Caribbean views
Blend of colonial architecture with modern luxury design
cons: Premium luxury pricing reflects high-end positioning
Urban setting within historic district rather than beachfront
